question: After dev-services/sentry-education merges, should the notes of dev-services/sentry also name the education plan, and should dev-services/sentry, compute/sentry and dev-services/sentry-education be related as variants?
why: The notes of dev-services/sentry name only the open source sponsorship plan, which is compute/sentry. A discover unit has no existing record in its scope, so it cannot relate records or change a note.
